name: Kimi wa Ore no Mono
source:
Cold or gentle, handsome or cute? The heroine is blindsided by both.
These are her handsome manager and the cute assistant at the cafe she now works part-time. 
Caught in between the two, she has a choice to make: melt the Devil's heart or ride into the sunset with the Prince.

[taken from [url=https://www.comino.app/officestory]official website[/url]]
translation:
冷酷还是温柔，帅气还是可爱？女主角被这两件事弄得措手不及。
这是她英俊的经理和她现在兼职的咖啡馆里可爱的助理。
夹在两者之间，她必须做出选择：融化魔鬼的心，还是与王子一起驰骋在夕阳下。

[摘自[url=https://www.comino.app/officestory]官方网站[/url]]
